notes: Read-only discovery of recent route bindings associated with Astra control continuations. Do not alter bridge, routes, runtime, services, code or market state.

operations.content:
from pathlib import Path
import json,time
DATA=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
rows=[]
for p in (DATA/'continuations').glob('CONT-*.json'):
 try:o=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
 except Exception:continue
 if not isinstance(o,dict):continue
 kind=str(o.get('external_source_kind') or '')
 if 'ASTRA' not in kind:continue
 rows.append((float(o.get('updated_at') or o.get('created_at') or 0),str(o.get('expected_route_task_id') or ''),str(o.get('chat_id') or ''),kind,str(o.get('state') or ''),int(o.get('attempts') or 0),int(o.get('last_acked_attempt') or 0)))
rows.sort(reverse=True)
# classify whether there is any recent Astra continuation whose route has actually ACKed delivery
if any(r[6]>=1 for r in rows[:30]): raise SystemExit(41)
# classify whether Astra continuations exist but none have ever ACKed recently
if rows: raise SystemExit(42)
raise SystemExit(43)
